messages:
ana: quick design review for prompt-sets & evals UI. Items: staged-approval vs immediate, compact vs annotated diffs, scorecard wording, keyboard/screenreader quirks. figs: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 30-36) :spiral_calendar:
kevin: TL;DR: prefer staged-approval (soft state) for bulk ops so we can show a single revert panel instead of modal spam. small batches can still use instant approve + undo.
maria: What's small? I suggest <=50 items = instant approve + 8s toast undo. 51-500 = staged-approval with quick revert in sidebar. >500 = start approval job with audit id and progress card.
ben: Staged-approval idea is nice for reviewers. UX: show a subtle badge on each example that is "staged" and allow per-item unstage. Also surface audit id in example metadata.
tom: A11y: toast must be announced (role=alert) and revert panel must be keyboard-focusable. For staged badges, ensure `aria-pressed` or a clear status text for SR users.
kevin: Good call. For keyboard flow, allow range-select (shift+arrow) then `A` to stage, `U` to unstage. Document in keyboard shortcuts modal.
maria: Compact vs annotated diffs: propose default = annotated for first-timers, but when a user toggles compact we persist in account prefs. Compact should show inline change markers and no helper annotations.
nana: One product nuance: some review teams need exact counts shown up-front. For staged-approval, indicate exact counts in the sidebar since staging can be partial. Don't call it "Select all" if it's only in-view.
ben: Microcopy: replace "Select all in view" -> "Select all visible examples (approx.)" and show exact count in tooltip on hover. Finance/usage will rely on confirmed job counts.
eva-bot: Visual scan: annotated mode callout background fails 3:1 for icons at 11px. Recommend using larger icon or darker tone.
tom: For compact mode, inline comment button currently isn't reachable by keyboard in a11y test rs-compact-078. Suspect tabindex=-1 on generated elements.
kevin: I'll take rs-compact-078. Fix plan: ensure inline controls have explicit tabindex=0 and that arrow-key row navigation doesn't get hijacked. ETA tomorrow AM.
maria: Scorecard legend copy feedback: "No judgement yet" confusing. Propose: "Not scored" + a short link "How scoring works". Also show numeric range 0-5 visually in the legend.
nana: Approval CTA wording: small batches -> `Approve 12 examples`. staged flow -> `Stage 12 approvals` and show `Finalize approvals` CTA in sidebar. For >500 -> `Start approval job`.
ben: For staged approvals, we should keep a short undo window after finalize (24 hours) but mark it as a heavier operation that produces an audit entry. Maybe allow org-admins to configure revert window.
tom: Accessibility for long-running job card: when job completes, announce polite aria-live. If it fails, assertive announce with link. Job card should be reachable via keyboard and have `aria-describedby` linking to logs summary.
maria: Copy tweak suggestion for finalize modal: from `Finalize approvals` -> `Finalize approvals — this will mark items as passed in the suite and create an audit entry. Revert allowed within 24h.` Clearer consequences.
nana: UX nit: annotated mode should auto-collapse unchanged blocks and show an "expand all" affordance. For compact, add a per-row hover state with a visible keyboard focus ring (2px).
kevin: We'll add roving tabindex for diff rows. Also add a `v` shortcut to toggle compact/annotated for power users. Persist it.
ben: QA: add a screenreader walkthrough to the checklist: 1) navigate table with arrows 2) stage items with shortcut 3) open revert panel 4) finalize job -> check polite/alert announcements.
eva-bot: Regression sniff: visual regression between annotated v2 and annotated v1 in high-contrast mode. Test id: rg-annotated-215 flagged missing focus ring.
maria: I'll update Figma to show thicker focus ring and adjust colors.
kevin: I'll open PR for the a11y fixes and keyboard shortcuts. @tom can you review?
tom: Yup. Also please add unit tests for: staged-state metadata, revert panel keyboard focus, toast SR announce, and rs-compact-078 fix.
nana: thanks all. Quick vote: staged-approval + annotated default, compact persisted toggle. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
